people.name: Gemariah
people.line: Son of Shaphan; official during Jehoiakim's reign; opposed burning scroll.

people.name: Micaiah
people.line: Son of Gemariah, reported Baruch's reading of Jeremiah's scroll.

people.name: Shaphan
people.line: Scribe during the reign of King Josiah

translations.web: When Micaiah the son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, had heard out of the book all Yahweh’s words,
translations.bsb: When Micaiah son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, heard all the words of the LORD from the scroll,
translations.kjv: When Michaiah the son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, had heard out of the book all the words of the LORD,
translations.asv: And when Micaiah the son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, had heard out of the book all the words of Jehovah,
